scope: Correct the recognized ACAD_PROXY_OBJECT DXF grammar so its data bit-size and bytes are not misread as proxy-entity graphics, while preserving the entity-specific group-92 route.

formatContract.proxyEntity: Group 92 is graphics byte size; group 310 chunks carry graphics. Group 93 is entity-data bit size and following group 310 chunks carry entity data.
formatContract.proxyObject: Group 93 is object-data bit size and group 310 chunks carry object data. Group 92 is explicitly unused; proxy objects have no graphics.

implementation.productionChange: collectProxyDxfGroup rejects group 92 in the recognized proxy-object subclass before typed/raw callback publication; proxy-entity group-92 handling is unchanged.
testChanges: Generated ASCII/binary object and entity payload controls check their distinct group-92/group-93 storage lanes.
Generated ASCII/binary proxy-object input using entity-only group 92 is rejected before either callback.
Existing retained-budget ASCII/binary object controls now use group 93 with 16 bits and assert m_objectData plus an empty m_binaryData.

unrelatedFailures: DICTIONARYWDFLT copy clears default-entry parser state
DICTIONARYWDFLT assignment clears default-entry parser state
AcDs bodies bind by handle across distinct block owners and record orders
